notes: Variant assumption recorded as a fixed incline bench with a free barbell. Direct evidence is strongest for pectoralis major, anterior deltoid, and triceps brachii at 25-45 degree incline conditions; the exact bench angle is unresolved because the movement ID does not specify one. Serratus anterior and rotator cuff support roles are explicitly marked as inference from close horizontal bench/chest-press evidence, not direct incline-only measurements. No visible biceps brachii role was added because incline-specific biceps evidence was not strong enough for a useful app classification.
